Corner-specific waiver, ss_125C_3v00 only (ruling 2026-10-05, answers req-20261005T091748Z-2340426; not the person's own ruling): setup -1.19..-1.20 ns on the vco_out /2 prescaler loop (pre_q0) at the 3.0 ns vco_out period. That period can't occur at ss: sim_pvt run 5 (PASS, analog/reports/gate-sim_pvt.json) puts the VCO top at ~227 MHz (4.4 ns) at ss_125c_vm10 and vco_fmax peaks near 236 MHz (4.24 ns) across all corners, so the VCO never reaches 333 MHz. The /2 loop needs ~4.25 ns at ss, so at the real ss VCO rate it meets with ~0.15 ns; VCO and divider slow together on one die. ff/tt meet at 3.0 ns. Condition: the ~0.15 ns (3.5%) margin must cover VCO period jitter; vco_period_jitter_ps_rms is unmeasured at tt (sim_measure_missing, run 5) and must be measured; revisit if ~6 sigma nears 150 ps. VCO top speed in the spec is NOT lowered. Slew on uo_out[0]/[1] was fixed (clkbuf_8), not waived.

open_issues.note: Corner waiver, ss_125C_3v00 only, for the vco_out /2 toggle loop (u_pre_ff0) at the 2.7 ns vco_out clock: setup -1.16..-1.20 ns (was -1.49..-1.50 with dffrnq_4). tt +0.65, ff +1.43 meet. Why it can't close: the fastest reset toggle loop in gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0 is dffrnq_2 + inv_1, 3.36 ns at ss in Liberty with ideal wires and 3.65 ns routed (274 MHz, STA less the 0.25 ns uncertainty); no flop or latch pair reaches 2.7 ns at ss. Premise, unlike issue 7's: the VCO CAN exceed the stage at ss_pff pre-layout (310 MHz at the rail), so the waiver rests on these instead: (1) acquiring from Vctrl = 0, the loop model on the ss_pff calibration (blocks/pll/tb/prescaler_margin.py, reports/prescaler_margin.json) locks every lock-table point with a 3.65 ns stage; peaks 254 / 283 / 243 MHz for 6.25x4 / 5x5 / 12.5x2. 5 MHz x 5 has no margin (fails from 3.68 ns). (2) REQ-RECOVER: 1024 unlocked ref cycles force DN for 128 cycles, so a rail start recovers (6.25x4 at 189 us, 12.5x2 at 95 us). Not 5x5 (overshoots again), and a rail start at 6.25x3 false-locks at 300 MHz in the model, which recovery cannot see. (3) The post-layout sweep (task 261029-062920, not merged yet) puts the extracted VCO at ss_pff at 240 MHz at the rail, below 274 MHz; if that holds, the stage keeps up with the VCO at every corner. Revisit if that sweep changes, or if the VCO's post-layout ss ceiling passes ~270 MHz.

decisions.why: No library cell pair toggles at 2.7 ns at ss_125C_3v00 (best ~3.27 ns ideal, 3.65 ns routed). The loop model on the ss_pff calibration showed the old 4.2 ns stage locked every 200 MHz point at the rail; at 3.65 ns all lock from Vctrl=0. Recovery is the backstop for a VCO beyond the stage, since the analog never discharges vctrl. Digital-only, analog layout untouched.
